design_brief.palette: Background #0a0a0a, Surface #252525, Text #ffffff, Muted #a2a2a2, Primary #2ecc71, Accent #59acff
design_brief.typography: Headings: Noto Sans JP 700, 64-80px; Body: Noto Sans JP 500, 32-40px; Mono: Fragment Mono; Line-height: 1.5+
design_brief.motion: 300-500ms duration, ease-out, staggered fade and short slide reveals
design_brief.layout: 1920x1080, 4 scenes, high information density, logo in corner, generous margins, no word breaks
notes: Use Noto Sans JP for all Japanese text with weight 700 for headlines and 500 for body.
Include source chips for SDK languages, pip install command, and review site usage.
Ensure the logo is visible in a corner on every scene and the final scene includes a CTA and URL.
Apply 300-500ms fade and slide animations with staggered reveals for a calm, precise feel.
Maintain a line-height of at least 1.5 and avoid breaking Japanese words across lines.
Use the brand's primary color #2ecc71 for key highlights and accent #59acff for secondary elements.
